purpose: Illustrative service imagery, not supplier portraits or photographs of the villa.

prompts.chef: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 3:2 editorial lifestyle photograph for an illustrative private-chef service card on an elegant coastal villa website. A real-looking adult professional chef in an immaculate ivory jacket and pine-green apron, framed from shoulders to waist, carefully finishing an elegant plate of freshly cooked fish with citrus and herbs. Chef and food clearly visible together. Warm natural window light, tactile pale linen, subtle bronze tones, quiet sophisticated hospitality photography. Tight composition; softly blurred neutral background, no identifiable property or invented villa architecture, no visible faces needed. Natural hands and anatomy. No logos, text, watermarks, collage.
prompts.massage: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 3:2 editorial lifestyle photograph for an illustrative in-villa massage service card on an elegant coastal villa website. A clearly recognizable professional portable massage table with rounded face cradle, dressed in immaculate ivory linen, neatly rolled towels and a small plain amber massage oil bottle. Frame the table three-quarter view prominently, relaxed soft daylight and subtly blurred tropical greenery in the background. Serene sophisticated hospitality photography, restrained pine green and warm ivory palette. No people, no resort building or identifiable property, no permanent spa amenities, no swimming pool, no bed, no text, logos, watermarks or collage.
prompts.celebration: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 3:2 editorial lifestyle photograph for an illustrative celebration arrangement service card on an elegant coastal villa website. A beautiful intimate celebration vignette: two slender champagne flutes and an unbranded champagne bottle in a silver ice bucket, a small arrangement of white flowers, and a restrained cluster of ivory and champagne-gold balloons. All key objects legible in a tight composition. Ivory linen table, warm late-afternoon natural light, soft anonymous greenery in the background. Sophisticated quiet coastal luxury, tactile natural materials, photorealistic reflections and glass. No identifiable venue or villa architecture, no people, no lettering, logos, watermarks, numbers or collage.
